title: Disaster Recovery Services | ICST - Thailand
description: ICST specializes in disaster recovery for cooling towers, offering rapid damage assessment, emergency material sourcing, and expert rebuilding to restore operations efficiently.

layout.title: Disaster Recovery
layout.lede: When ICST arrived on-site, the damage from the typhoon was catastrophic. ICST was tasked with conducting a comprehensive disaster recovery assessment and procuring emergency materials to restore the cooling towers to full functionality.

paragraphs: Without power on the island, conditions were rough for the locals and ICST team as well.
This is how we left the towers, rebuilt, upgraded and the power plant ready to produce power.

sections.heading: Cooling Tower Disaster Recovery
paragraphs: After the Leyte typhoon devastated Malitbog’s cooling towers, Energy Development Corporation (EDC) urgently required professional disaster recovery services. ICST was the first response team on the ground, conducting:
✔ Damage assessment for critical cooling tower structures
✔ Comprehensive rehabilitation for three power plants with multiple towers

Following a natural disaster, timely and effective recovery services are crucial to restoring essential infrastructure. ICST specializes in disaster recovery for cooling towers, ensuring that affected facilities are not just repaired but also reinforced for long-term resilience.
By integrating advanced cooling tower engineering with emergency response expertise, ICST helps industries and communities recover faster and rebuild stronger.
